title: 📣 McLean, VA Sales & Marketing Roles with Multiple Six-Figure Paths - NewsBreak
text:
1 days ago McLean is buzzing with high-end sales, marketing, and growth roles, especially in finance, tech, and federal consulting. If you’ve got client-facing chops or product skills, this is a strong moment to level up.
Lead Credit Product Sales Specialist (Commercial Banking) Employer: Wells Fargo
Location: McLean, VA (Hybrid, 4 days in office)
Type: Full-time
Salary: Approx. $139,000 – $260,000 base (location-dependent; plus incentives)
Senior credit sales role in equipment finance, owning lease and loan deals from origination through funding with an annual funded volume target of $30MM+ . Great fit if you have 5+ years in secured/specialized lending sales , strong financial analysis skills, and like mentoring junior teammates and traveling (~35%).
Lead Merchant Product Sales Consultant, Government Banking Employer: Wells Fargo
Location: McLean, VA (Hybrid)
Type: Full-time
Salary: $119,000 – $224,000 base (plus incentives)
Consultative B2B sales role focused on government and public-sector clients for merchant services and digital payment solutions. Ideal for someone with 5+ years B2B sales and experience in payments, merchant services, or treasury who likes building executive relationships and traveling up to 30%.
Director of Customer Success Employer: Pixalate
Location: Hybrid from VA or NY (DC or NY metro)
Type: Full-time
Salary: Not listed
Lead and grow the Customer Success team at a fast-moving ad tech company focused on fraud prevention and privacy. Best for a programmatic advertising pro (SSP/DSP/ad tech background) with 4+ years client-facing CS / technical account / sales experience and a track record hitting revenue and retention goals.
Product Manager – Trade Credit (Manager, Product Management) Employer: Capital One
Location: McLean, VA
Type: Full-time
Salary (McLean): $164,800 – $188,100 base (plus performance incentives)
Own the end-to-end lifecycle for trade credit products, turning data and user insights into digital features that drive business outcomes. Great if you have either a quantitative/business degree or 3+ years of product management , and enjoy human-centered, tech-driven problem solving.
Pinnacle Capture Leader – Energy Providers Employer: Guidehouse
Location: McLean, VA (Heavy travel up to 75%+)
Type: Full-time
Salary: $179,000 – $298,000
High-impact capture and growth role for large, complex tech-enabled deals ( $10M–$100M+ ) in the Energy Providers space. A strong match if you bring 8–10 years with EP clients , 5–10 years of large capture experience , and like owning win strategies, teaming, pricing, and proposal leadership.
Federal Health Account Growth Leader Employer: Guidehouse
Location: McLean, VA / DC-based , up to 75%+ travel
Type: Full-time
Salary: Not listed
Own growth for major Federal Health accounts , especially VA , with a focus on net-new opportunities and large technology modernizations. Designed for someone with 10+ years in Federal Health sales/capture, strong C‑suite presence, and experience scaling accounts from point solutions to multi-service portfolios.
Pinnacle Capture Leader | Federal Health Employer: Guidehouse
Location: McLean, VA
Type: Full-time
Salary: $155,000 – $259,000
Lead major Federal Health pursuits across HHS and VA, from shaping requirements through bid/no-bid and proposal delivery. Best for someone with 10+ years advising Federal Health clients and 5+ years of $10M+ capture who wants to drive strategy, teaming, and pricing on high-dollar deals.
Marketing Coordinator Employer: Transwestern
Location: McLean, VA
Type: Full-time
Salary: $55,000 – $65,000
Hands-on marketing and design role supporting commercial real estate business development and leasing. Great fit if you have 3+ years of marketing , are strong in Adobe InDesign and Creative Cloud , and like creating proposals, pitch decks, email campaigns, and event materials in a fast-paced, team setting.
AI-Powered Cyber Defense Product Sales Engineer Employer: Booz Allen Hamilton
Location: McLean, VA (Hybrid/Client-facing, up to 50% travel)
Type: Full-time
Salary: $77,600 – $176,000
Senior sales engineer role selling AI-driven cyber defense products to SOCs across federal, defense, and commercial clients. Ideal if you have 5+ years in cybersecurity in a customer-facing technical role , Secret clearance , and enjoy demos, architecture talks, and shaping solutions with product teams.
